name: Robin Schamber
residence: Sublette County (2026 general candidate listing, Pinedale)
occupation: Sublette County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Robin Schamber is a Sublette County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Mack Bradley, who is serving through the current term. Official 2026 general results show she received 1,831 votes, second of two seats. She previously appeared on the 2022 Republican primary ballot for county commissioner. No separate public-record account of her private occupation or education was found in the official pages and other public records reviewed for this Profile.
